note: RobotWin Studio English language pack. Keys are the interface's source texts (Turkish), values their English. Patterns: {…} in a key is any text (a number, a name), {0} {1} … in the value take them in order. To make another language, copy this file to xx.json, set "language" and "culture", and translate the values; what it does not translate falls back to English.

strings.Direnç, gücü ısıya çevirir; anma gücünü: A resistor turns power into heat; above its rated power the body heats up, chars and fails open.
strings.Diyot ileri yönde anma akımının, ters y: The diode was driven above its rated current in the forward direction, or above its breakdown voltage in reverse.
strings.Elektrolitik kondansatörler ters gerili: Electrolytic capacitors heat up inside under reverse voltage and produce gas; the top swells and they burst.

strings.Mikrodenetleyici pini en çok 20 mA (mut: A microcontroller pin can supply at most 20 mA (absolute limit 40 mA); drive an LED through a series resistor, and loads such as motors/relays through a transistor or MOSFET.
strings.Motor sürücü sürekli akım sınırının üst: The motor driver was pushed above its continuous current limit.
strings.Sargı akımı I²·R kadar ısı üretir; moto: Winding current produces I²·R of heat; when the motor stalls, the current rises to its maximum and the winding burns out.

strings.1 m açıklıklı RC planör gerçek yapısıyla: A 1 m span RC glider with its real structure: 2S LiPo, Arduino Nano, elevator and rudder servos and nose lead in a balsa cabin; pushrods along the carbon tail boom; Clark Y wing with 6° dihedral; 233 g, centre of gravity at 33% of the chord. Hand-launched from 40 m at 7 m/s, it glides at ~10:1; the sketch flies straight for 3 s and then turns gently with the rudder.
strings.1 m planör gerçek bir elektrikli İHA gib: The 1 m glider as a real electric UAV: a 2212 1000KV brushless motor and 8×4.5" propeller in the nose (~5 N thrust on 3S), 20 A ESC, a 3S 850 mAh battery that brings the centre of gravity to 30% by its position alone instead of nose lead, ESP32 + MPU-6050 flight board. Held in the hand for 2,5 s (the ESC arms, the IMU calibrates), thrown, climbs under power, then glides.
strings.1 m'lik eğitim uçağı asfalt pistin başın: A 1 m trainer aircraft stands at the start of an asphalt runway: balsa cabin, carbon tail boom, Clark Y wing with ailerons, elevator and rudder with pushrods, tricycle landing gear with free-rolling nose and main wheels, 2212 brushless motor, 8×4,5" propeller, 3S LiPo, ESP32 + MPU-6050 flight board (Bluepad32). Options (Enter on the keyboard) arms the motor; R2 (F) throttle, right stick (I/J/K/L) roll and pitch, left stick (A/D) rudder, △ (R) Stabilised / Manual mode, ✕ (Space) cuts the motor. Once the speed passes ~10 m/s, pull the stick back and the aircraft takes off. If it goes out of Bluetooth range, the motor is cut and the aircraft glides in circles. Camera: Pilot view.

strings.Altimetre tırmanmanın bittiğini görünce: When the altimeter sees that the climb has ended, the parachute is deployed; once the lines are taut, the canopy opens over Knacke's inflation time (t = 8·D/v) and its drag is attached to the top of the body. Opening shock and swinging come from the physics.
strings.Alüminyum gövdede iki BATES şeker yakıt: Two BATES sugar propellant grains in an aluminium casing, converging-diverging nozzle with a 6 mm throat. Ignited at 0.1 s; the burn rate depends on pressure (r = a·pⁿ), the pressure comes from the balance between the burning surface and the nozzle flow, and thrust and burn time follow from it. Make the throat smaller: the pressure rises and the casing bursts.

strings.Arabanın kendi kartı var: ESP32 ve DRV88: The car has its own board: an ESP32 and a DRV8833 on a carrier PCB with screw terminals, running on a 2S 18650 pack charged via USB-C (not connected to the computer). The motors are mounted mirrored as in a real kit, both shafts on one axle. Select the board and use 'Edit board' to open its circuit, PCB and Bluepad32 code. R2 throttle, L2 reverse, left stick steering. Gamepad: a real DualSense connected to the computer via USB or Bluetooth, otherwise the on-screen virtual gamepad (keyboard: W/S throttle, A/D steering).

strings.E-match (elektrikli ateşleyici) motora m: If an e-match (electric igniter) is mechanically attached to the motor, the igniter burns the moment it is fired from the circuit. The propellant doesn't burn immediately: the igniter's hot gas heats the surface, the region that reaches ignition temperature (KNSB ≈ 317 °C) burns and the flame spreads towards the nozzle. An e-match head alone (≈ 0.03 g) usually can't ignite sugar propellant.

strings.Kabın içindeki gaz ideal gaz yasasıyla (: The gas inside the vessel is computed with the ideal gas law (with the Noble–Abel real-gas correction for hot combustion products), the outflow from the nozzle with isentropic flow (choking at the throat, Schmucker separation when over-expanded), and water with Bernoulli. The igniter's hot gas heats the solid propellant, which burns once its surface reaches ignition temperature, and the flame spreads; the burn rate depends on pressure and on the channel flow (erosive burning). Thrust, mass loss, wall and nozzle heating, and bursting all come from the same physics.

strings.Sekiz QRE1113, 9.525 mm aralıklı. Her çı: Eight QRE1113s, 9.525 mm apart. Each output is a phototransistor with a 47 kΩ pull-up: near VCC on black, low on white. Best at 3 mm, at most 6 mm. LEDON LOW = emitters off.

Retro-reflective and through-beam: the beam goes to a reflector or receiver at the range, and anything between cuts it. OUT is high in the chosen state, after the response time.

strings.8 sayısal giriş (I0–I7 → %IX0.0–%IX0.7),: 8 digital inputs (I0–I7 → %IX0.0–%IX0.7), 8 digital outputs (Q0–Q7 ← %QX0.0–%QX0.7). Its program is Structured Text (ST): BOOL, INT, REAL, TIME; TON, TOF, TP, R_TRIG, F_TRIG, CTU, CTD, CTUD, SR, RS; IF, CASE (station steps), FOR, WHILE, REPEAT. Every cycle time it reads the inputs, runs the program once and writes the outputs. A program that does not compile, or a fault while running (division by zero, a loop that does not end), puts the PLC in STOP with its outputs off.

strings.Anahtarlamalı düşürücü: girişi daha düşü: Switching step-down: brings its input down to a lower, adjustable output, much cooler than a linear regulator. The output stays at least its dropout below the input; a load past the current limit pulls the output down.
strings.Anahtarlamalı yükseltici: girişi daha yü: Switching step-up: lifts its input to a higher, adjustable output (5 V from a single Li-ion cell, say). When it is not switching, the input passes to the output through its diode.
strings.Ters toparlanma süresi ve yüksek frekans: No reverse recovery time and no package inductance at high frequency.
strings.Isıl gürültü ile bacakların endüktansı v: No thermal noise, and no lead inductance or capacitance.
No wiper contact noise or wear.
strings.Seramikte gerilimle kapasite düşmesi (DC: No loss of capacitance with voltage in ceramics (DC bias) and no dielectric absorption.
No ageing and no change of ESR with temperature.
strings.Doyma yalnızca bir sınır denetimidir: en: Saturation is only a limit check: the inductance does not fall with current; no core loss or hysteresis.
strings.Işık çıkışı akımla doğrusal sayılır; ısı: Light output is taken as linear in current; no loss of brightness as it heats.
strings.Ebers–Moll tabanlı: yüksek akımda beta d: Ebers–Moll based: no fall of beta at high current and no base resistance.
strings.Seviye 1 (Shichman–Hodges): kısa kanal e: Level 1 (Shichman–Hodges): no short-channel effects, no subthreshold conduction and no drift of the threshold with temperature.
strings.Makro model: giriş kutuplama akımı, gürü: Macro model: no input bias current, no noise and no second pole.
strings.Doğrusal regülatörün geçici tepkisi ve b: The linear regulator's transient response and supply rejection (PSRR) do not change with frequency.
strings.Anahtarlama periyodu üzerinden ortalamal: Averaged over the switching period: no output ripple and no EMI.
strings.Döngü çipin kendi kompanzasyonu değil, g: The loop is a general PI, not the chip's own compensation; discontinuous conduction (DCM) shows only as the current stopping at zero.
strings.Yaşlanma, sıcaklığın kapasiteye etkisi v: No ageing, no effect of temperature on capacity and no relaxation (polarisation) time constants.
strings.Fırça ve komütasyon dalgalanması, mıknat: No brush and commutation ripple, no heating of the magnets and no saturation of the winding.
strings.İç denetleyici ve dişli boşluğu sadeleşt: The internal controller and gear backlash are simplified; no potentiometer noise.
strings.Mıknatısın sıcaklıkla zayıflaması ve sar: No weakening of the magnets with temperature and no winding saturation; resonance comes only from the mechanics.
strings.Kıyıcı (chopper) PWM'i ortalamalı: faz a: The chopper PWM is averaged: no phase-current ripple and no detail of the decay modes (slow/mixed).
The chopper PWM is averaged: no phase-current ripple and no detail of the decay modes.
strings.Yalnızca bağımsız kip: UART ayarları, St: Standalone mode only: no UART settings, StallGuard, CoolStep or StealthChop's silence.
strings.Kontak sıçraması (bounce) yok: basış tem: No contact bounce: a press is a clean transition.
strings.Kontak sıçraması (bounce) yok: geçiş tem: No contact bounce: the transition is clean.
strings.Kontak sıçraması (bounce) ve kontak aşın: No contact bounce and no contact wear.
strings.Filamanın ısınması tek bir zaman sabitiy: The filament heats with a single time constant; the light's colour does not change with temperature.
strings.Ölçüm tek bir ışınla yapılır: ses konisi: It measures along a single ray: the width of the sound cone and the echo lost to a surface's angle are simplified.
strings.ATmega328P komut düzeyinde çalışır; bazı: The ATmega328P runs instruction by instruction; some peripherals' analog details (the ADC's sampling capacitor, clock drift) are simplified.
strings.Hızlı kipte Arduino API'si modellenir; d: In fast mode the Arduino API is modelled; in hardware mode the core is emulated. The Wi-Fi and BLE radio is a model in both.
strings.I²t ısınma modeli: üreticinin erime eğri: I²t heating model: not the maker's exact melting curve, and no arcing time.

The spinning head is stuck: no new scans come.

strings.Dünya çalışırken RX ve TX bacaklarından: While the world runs it answers the requests coming in on its RX and TX pins.
strings.8 sayısal giriş, 8 sayısal çıkış; dünya: 8 digital inputs, 8 digital outputs; while the world runs it is a Modbus TCP server that a PLC, HMI or SCADA program connects to as to a real module. Coils 0–7 → DO1–DO8 (written), discrete inputs 0–7 ← DI1–DI8 (read); input register 0 is the inputs' bit word, holding register 0 the outputs'. Four 0–10 V analog inputs (AI1–AI4 → input registers 1–4) and two 0–10 V analog outputs (holding registers 1–2 → AO1–AO2), in millivolts, 12 bits. With the bus set to RTU the same table is served by Modbus RTU on the 5 V TTL serial header (RX, TX): a microcontroller is the master over a cable.
strings.G/Ç: I0–I7 → %IX0.0–%IX0.7, Q0–Q7 ← %QX0: I/O: I0–I7 → %IX0.0–%IX0.7, Q0–Q7 ← %QX0.0–%QX0.7, %MW0–%MW255 memory words. Types BOOL, INT, DINT, UINT, WORD, REAL, TIME; blocks TON, TOF, TP, R_TRIG, F_TRIG, CTU, CTD, CTUD, SR, RS; Modbus client MB_READ, MB_WRITE.
strings.Çift etkili silindir ve üstündeki tek bo: Double-acting cylinder with a single-coil 5/2 valve on top (the rod comes out along +X): when the SOL coil is energised the piston goes out, when released it comes back. Each chamber is solved as its own mass of air: ISO 6358 flow through the valve, air that heats as it fills and cools as it expands; the force is pressure × area, and the seals rub. EXT and RET are the outputs of the magnetic sensors at the end positions. The speed setting throttles the exhaust (meter-out speed control). The coil is a real load in the circuit. With a double-solenoid valve SOL sends it out and SOL2 back; with both released the valve stays where it was. Name a compressor as its air source and the supply comes from that compressor's tank (the regulator gives at most the supply pressure).
strings.Pistonlu kompresör, tankı ve basınç anah: A piston compressor, its tank and pressure switch: the motor starts when the tank falls to the lower pressure and stops at the upper. Cylinders that name this compressor as their air draw from the tank: draw too much and the pressure falls, the cylinders slow down and weaken. RUN is high while the motor runs, PS while the tank is above the lower pressure. The tank air is held at room temperature (isothermal).
strings.6–8 bar, küçük tank: sık devreye girer: 6–8 bar, a small tank: it cuts in often
strings.Hava kaynağı (kompresör adı; boş = sabit: Air source (a compressor's name; empty = a fixed supply)

strings.Dünya çalışırken tank basıncı ve motor b: While the world runs, the tank pressure and the motor show here.
strings.Körüklü vakum vantuzu: düz bir yüzeye ot: Bellows vacuum suction cup: holds once it seats on a flat surface and seals; holding force = vacuum × cup area. It doesn't hold on tilted/edge contact. The vacuum comes from a pump or from an ejector (a venturi) run on compressed air: an ejector's vacuum rises with its supply pressure (about 4.5 bar for its full vacuum) and, while on, it draws air from the compressor's tank.
